# ScriptCore.AI Activity Shapes Reference

Reference catalog of the Script Editor's activity shapes, grouped by the kind of programming-language control construct each one plays &mdash; sequence, selection, iteration, concurrency, exception handling, state, I/O, subroutines/events, semantic calls, and security. `ChatInput`, `ChatOutput`, and domain-specific shapes (e.g. `InsuranceDecisionActivity`) are excluded.

## Contents

- [Sequence / Program Structure](#sequence-program-structure)
- [Selection (Conditionals & Branching)](#selection-conditionals-branching)
- [Iteration (Loops)](#iteration-loops)
- [Concurrency](#concurrency)
- [Exception Handling](#exception-handling)
- [Variables & State](#variables-state)
- [Input / Output](#input-output)
- [Events & Subroutines (Topic Flow)](#events-subroutines-topic-flow)
- [Semantic / AI Calls](#semantic-ai-calls)
- [Security](#security)

## Sequence / Program Structure

The plain statements and block structure of a script &mdash; run one thing, run a block, wait, or stop.

### SimpleActivity

The basic building block of a flow: runs a single action &mdash; a static message or a defined action &mdash; and then moves on to the next activity in sequence, similar to a single statement in a program.

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Mode | `mode` | message or action |
| Message | `message` | Learning mode intro message |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![SimpleActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)

### CompositeActivity

Acts like a function body or block. It groups a fixed number of child activities and runs them one after another in sequence, resuming automatically after any waits inside them.

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Child Count | `childCount` | 8 |
| Isolate Context | `isolateContext` | false |
| Complete Message | `completeMessage` | Composite completed |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![CompositeActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |

|---|---|

| Output | output |

## Selection (Conditionals & Branching)

if / switch style constructs that pick one branch out of several based on a context value.

> **Known issue &mdash; no per-branch ports.** Every shape in this category (`ConditionalActivity`, `Conditional<QuickAnswer>`, `Conditional<TriggerTopic>`, `DecisionActivity`, `SwitchActivity`, `ChoiceActivity`) exposes only the generic `Input` / `Output` / `Exception` / `Control` ports &mdash; confirmed by inspecting each node's live port list in the editor. Branch/case selection is entirely data-driven through fields like `Cases`, `Case Keys`, `Branch Match`, and `Default Case`; there is no separate connectable output port per case or branch. In practice this means only one downstream node can be wired from the single `Output` port, even though the node conceptually has multiple distinct outcomes. This is a known limitation of the current editor, not an intentional design &mdash; it is expected to be addressed by the upcoming ScriptEditor rewrite rather than patched in the current implementation.

### ConditionalActivity

A general-purpose if/switch construct. It reads a context value through a selector key and picks a branch to execute among a set of defined cases, with an optional default case.

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Selector Key | `selectorKey` | ConditionKey |
| Cases | `cases` | case-a \| case-b |
| Default Branch | `defaultBranch` | (none) |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![ConditionalActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)

---

### Conditional<QuickAnswer>

A specialized conditional that branches on the label of the last QuickAnswer decision, then runs a QuickAnswerActivity for the matched branch &mdash; like a switch over the previous user choice.

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Selector Key | `selectorKey` | Basics_LastDecisionLabel |
| Branch Match | `branchMatch` | StillLearning -> ask |
| Default Branch | `defaultBranch` | (none) |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![Conditional<QuickAnswer> node](data:image/png;base64,)

|---|---|

### DecisionActivity

A semantic (LLM-backed) decision node. It evaluates evidence from context using a model and can require the output to be structured JSON, functioning like a rule engine call embedded in the flow.

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Evidence Context Key | `evidenceContextKey` | DecisionEvidence |
| Model Id | `modelId` | gpt-4o |
| Temperature | `temperature` | 0.3 |
| Require JSON | `requireJson` | true |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![DecisionActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)

### SwitchActivity

A classic switch/case construct keyed off a context value, with an optional loop-back after a case runs and a default case for unmatched values.

> See the [category-level note above](#selection-conditionals-branching) &mdash; this node's `Case Keys` do not each get their own output port; all cases and the default share the single generic `Output` port.

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Value Context Key | `valueContextKey` | SwitchKey |
| Case Keys | `caseKeys` | case-a \| case-b |
| Loop After Case | `loopAfterCase` | false |
| Default Case | `defaultCase` | (none) |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![SwitchActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)

---

## Iteration (Loops)

Looping constructs: repeat a step under a condition, or iterate a collection.

### RepeatActivity

Wraps a single child activity and re-runs it under a loop condition (e.g. a while-predicate), comparable to a while loop around one statement.

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Loop Mode | `loopMode` | while predicate |
| Collection Key | `collectionKey` | BasicsLearningLoop_Collection |
| Continue Prompt | `continuePrompt` | custom predicate controls continuation |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![RepeatActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)

---

### ForEachActivity

Iterates over a context collection, running the child flow once per item and exposing the current item and index as context keys &mdash; a for-each loop over a collection.

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Collection Key | `collectionKey` | Items |
| Item Key | `itemKey` | item |
| Index Key | `indexKey` | index |
| Start Message | `startMessage` | _(empty)_ |
| Complete Message | `completeMessage` | _(empty)_ |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![ForEachActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)

## Concurrency

Running more than one branch at the same time.

### ParallelActivity

Runs a fixed number of child branches concurrently and merges their completion, with an option to continue even if one branch errors &mdash; analogous to fork/join concurrency.

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Branch Count | `branchCount` | 2 |
| Continue On Error | `continueOnError` | false |
| Complete Message | `completeMessage` | _(empty)_ |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![ParallelActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)

## Exception Handling

try/catch-style constructs: handling errors, falling back, or escalating to a human.

### OnErrorActivity

Catches exceptions raised elsewhere in the flow and surfaces a friendly error message to the user, acting like a catch block.

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Error Message | `errorMessage` | An unexpected error occurred. |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![OnErrorActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)

---

### FallbackActivity

Runs when no other route in the flow matches the current input, serving as the default/else branch of the whole script, and flags that a fallback occurred.

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Message | `message` | Sorry, I did not understand that. |
| Fallback Flag Key | `fallbackFlagKey` | FallbackTriggered |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![FallbackActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)

---

### EscalateActivity

Ends automated handling and requests a human handoff, flagging the escalation in context &mdash; comparable to re-throwing to an outer handler (a human).

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Escalation Message | `escalationMessage` | Transferring to a human agent |
| Escalation Flag Key | `escalationFlagKey` | EscalationRequested |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![EscalateActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)

## Input / Output

The language's I/O statements: prompting, displaying, and reading things back from the user.

### WaitForUserInput

Shows a prompt and blocks the flow until the user supplies free-form text, storing it (and an inferred model, if configured) in context.

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Prompt | `prompt` | Ask your question about insurance basics: |
| Model Context Key | `modelContextKey` | wait_for_user_input |

### AdaptiveCardActivity

Renders an Adaptive Card built from connected card/model definition nodes and waits for the user's submission, storing it under a context key.

> **Missing feature &mdash; no card editor.** The `Card` and `Model` fields are currently plain text inputs that just read `(not connected)` until a definition node is wired in elsewhere; there is no in-editor UI for authoring the Adaptive Card layout or its data model directly on this node. The intended experience is a dedicated Adaptive Card editor (element palette + live WYSIWYG canvas + property inspector, in the same visual language as the rest of the Script Editor) reachable from this activity, similar to Microsoft's standalone Adaptive Cards Designer. See a mockup of the proposed editor in [`docs/diagrams/adaptive-card-editor-mockup.html`](diagrams/adaptive-card-editor-mockup.html).

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Card | `card` | (not connected) |
| Model | `model` | (not connected) |
| Submission Context Key | `submissionContextKey` | adaptive-card-activity-1 |
| Required | `required` | true |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Card | input |
| Model | input |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![AdaptiveCardActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)

## Events & Subroutines (Topic Flow)

Calling into and returning from other topics, and reacting to routing/UI events &mdash; the function-call mechanics of the language.

### EventTriggerActivity

Raises a custom UI event, optionally waiting (up to a timeout) for a response that gets stored in context &mdash; an outbound signal with an optional synchronous reply.

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Event Name | `eventName` | CustomEvent |
| Wait For Response | `waitForResponse` | false |
| Response Context Key | `responseContextKey` | (none) |
| Timeout (ms) | `timeoutMs` | 300000 |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![EventTriggerActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)

---

### TriggerTopicActivity

Signals the orchestrator to start another topic, optionally waiting for that topic to complete before continuing &mdash; like a fire-and-forget or awaited subroutine call.

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Topic To Trigger | `topicToTrigger` | CoverageEstimateTopic |
| Wait For Completion | `waitForCompletion` | false |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![TriggerTopicActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)

---

### ExecuteTopicActivity

Runs another named topic as a subroutine and returns its result into a context key once it completes, similar to calling a function and capturing the return value.

**Parameters**

|---|---|---|

| Result Context Key | `resultContextKey` | execute-topic-activity-1_TopicResult |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![ExecuteTopicActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |

## Semantic / AI Calls

Built-in calls out to a model or rule engine for retrieval and structured reasoning.

### SemanticResponse

Builds a retrieval-augmented prompt from a named evidence collection and the user's last message, optionally skipping the LLM call entirely when a match exceeds a confidence threshold.

**Parameters**

| Label | Key | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Collection | `collection` | insurance_basics_intel |
| User Prompt Key | `userPromptKey` | Basics_UserPrompt |
| Skip LLM Threshold | `skipLlmThreshold` | 0.9 |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![SemanticResponse node](data:image/png;base64,)

---

### SemanticQueryActivity

Runs a rule-set-driven semantic query against a configured input source and writes typed JSON output to a context key, optionally in the background.

| Label | Key | Default value |

| Run In Background | `runInBackground` | false |

**Ports**

| Port | Direction |
|---|---|
| Input | input |
| Output | output |
| Exception | output |
| Control | output |

**Snapshot**

![SemanticQueryActivity node](data:image/png;base64,)
